set.body:
Found in review of the S3a follow-ups (cdaa540ae), and produced by a test on 9252b8129 (document ReferentIdentitySuite "simultaneity does not cross bundles that share an axis").
SourceStream.of (core/source.scala ~979-995) accepts any PresentationAxisId as a stream's native axis, and SourceBundle.validate checks only mapping axes (~1078). SourceSupportChecks.playback (support.scala ~164) then admits an anchor whose axis equals that stream's native axis. So bundle B2 can declare a picture stream whose native axis is film F1's primary axis, and intervals built on F1's axis anchor in B2: two films appear to share footage time.
Consequence measured so far: document's referent overlap had to add a bundle check (9252b8129). Any other consumer that treats an equal axis as the same footage (alignment, playback projection) may fail open the same way; not yet surveyed.
Root fix: SourceBundle.of refuses a stream whose native axis is neither the bundle's primary axis nor an axis that one of its own mappings declares. This changes core validation; reference-scope will be wide, and the storyatlas4s sibling seam applies.
set.title: core: a stream may declare another bundle's axis as its native axis
